title: Write the board as operations against a fresh read in main
notes: board-view.ts:268 saves the whole in-memory board and can erase an agent's board move made just before. Send move/set/comment to main and apply them to a fresh read, like runBoardCommandOnLatest. Cost medium. (docs/review/2026-11-01.md R2)

comments.body: Shipped in PR #183: board:write takes the screen's last-read board beside the new one, and main replays the card-by-card change onto a fresh read (rebaseBoardChange in board-merge.ts), so a card the board command moved is no longer erased by the app's next save. board.json format unchanged.
